title: How do I exchange an item?

contents.content:
We offer exchanges in store on most items based on the return policy window. If an exchange can't be completed, a return and purchase of a new item may be offered within the return policy and return window. We'll do our best to honor your promotional or sale price but there may be differences based on tender used, coupons and offers applied.  

If you’d like to exchange an item purchased on Target.com, call Target.com Guest Services at 1-800-591-3869. If the item you want is available, we can process a return and place a new order for the item, honoring the original purchase price.

Note: Items sold by Target Plus Partners cannot be exchanged.
